content.short: T3tris Finance lets managers deploy and operate async ERC-4626 vaults on any EVM chain.
content.description: T3tris Finance provides infrastructure for deploying and curating asynchronous ERC-4626 vaults, where deposits and withdrawals settle on a delay rather than instantly. Asynchronous settlement is what allows a vault to hold strategies that cannot be unwound on demand, which covers most things yielding more than a money market.
